game_name: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Mirai e no Isan (Japan 990913, NO CD)
general_issues: Select jojobanr2.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. TPO automatically assigns up to 2 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
